items.name: hold-to-confirm-button
items.title: Hold to Confirm Button
items.description: A button for risky actions that only confirms after it's held down.

items.name: shimmer-button
items.title: Shimmer Button
items.description: A button with an animated shimmer sweep.

items.name: smooth-caret-input
items.title: Smooth Caret Input
items.description: A text input whose caret glides between characters as new letters ease in.

items.name: seeker-search
items.title: Seeker Search
items.description: A search box whose placeholder types its own suggestions, with highlighted, keyboard-driven results.

items.name: caret-tag-input
items.title: Caret Tag Input
items.description: A tag field where every new tag flies out of the caret and lands as a chip.

items.name: dial-number-input
items.title: Dial Number Input
items.description: A number you spin like a combination lock: drag, scroll or use the arrow keys.

items.name: stretch-switch
items.title: Stretch Switch
items.description: A switch whose thumb stretches like a drop of liquid as it travels.

items.name: rocker-switch
items.title: Rocker Switch
items.description: A physical light-switch rocker that tilts, with real light and shadow.

items.name: ink-checkbox
items.title: Ink Checkbox
items.description: A checkbox where ink bleeds out from your click, then the check draws itself.

items.name: caret-loader
items.title: Caret Loader
items.description: A caret that types a row of dots, deletes them and types again.

items.name: perforation-progress
items.title: Perforation Progress
items.description: A progress bar drawn as a tear line, with a wave across it at 100%.

items.name: etch-skeleton
items.title: Etch Skeleton
items.description: A loading placeholder where a caret writes each line instead of shimmering.

items.name: stretch-tabs
items.title: Stretch Tabs
items.description: Tabs whose indicator stretches in the direction it moves, then settles.

items.name: fold-accordion
items.title: Fold Accordion
items.description: An accordion whose panels unfold like a sheet of paper.

items.name: perforated-card
items.title: Perforated Card
items.description: A ticket-style card with a stub you tear off to reveal hidden content.

items.name: ticket-toast
items.title: Ticket Toast
items.description: Notifications shaped like tickets. Dismiss one and its stub tears off.

items.name: rewrite-text
items.title: Rewrite Text
items.description: Text that rewrites itself: the caret selects a word, deletes it and types the next.

items.name: caret-field
items.title: Caret Field
items.description: A background of tiny carets that turn toward the cursor, with an occasional blink.

items.name: elastic-divider
items.title: Elastic Divider
items.description: A divider line that bends toward the cursor like a string and wobbles back.
